create_ScientificPapersConfig: create a ScientificPapersConfig builder config for arxiv or pubmed dataset source
build_Builder: build a GeneratorBasedBuilder for the scientific papers dataset with arxiv and pubmed configs
run__info: run the _info method to return dataset features including article, abstract, and section_names
run__split_generators: run _split_generators to download and extract dataset splits for train, validation, and test
run__generate_examples: run _generate_examples to yield article summaries and section names from JSON lines files
